name: Forevermore
description: This is the story of Xander, the rebellious and irresponsible unico hijo of a hotel magnate, and the feisty and hardworking Strawberry Jam Queen of La Trinidad, Benguet, Agnes. Xander and Agnes’ extraordinary relationship starts after an intoxicated Xander crash lands his parachute into a strawberry truck. To teach him a lesson, his parents made him pay for the damages he caused by making him work at the strawberry farm under the guidance of Agnes and other strawberry farmers.

videos.title: Episode 001
videos.overview: Do you believe that love lasts forever? Xander (Enrique Gil) and Agnes (Liza Soberano) find the answer as they both jump into the unknown.

videos.title: Episode 002
videos.overview: A dream will come true, but will gold be placed by Agnes (Liza Soberano) from heaven?

videos.title: Episode 003
videos.overview: Xander (Enrique Gil) will taste the bitter anger of Agnes (Liza Soberano). But the bitter treatment may soon turn into a sweet relationship.

videos.title: Episode 004
videos.overview: Agnes (Liza Soberano) is desperate to do anything to save the land that has been her family's source of living. Is Xander (Enrique Gil) the answer to all her prayers?

videos.title: Episode 005
videos.overview: The person who refuses to commit sin, finds a way to escape. But Xander (Enrique Gil) might only make things worst for Agnes (Liza Soberano) and her family.

videos.title: Episode 006
videos.overview: Pride is Xander's (Enrique Gil) only shield from his father, but the same pride slowly destroys the lives of Agnes (Liza Soberano), her family and fellow farmers.

videos.title: Episode 007
videos.overview: What is suppose to be a storm of punishment for Xander (Enrique Gil) slowly becomes a sweet breeze of attraction between him and Agnes (Liza Soberano).

videos.title: Episode 008
videos.overview: Agnes (Liza Soberano) has lost patience for Xander (Enrique Gil). But sometimes ... the mouthpiece, chest tightness.

videos.title: Episode 009
videos.overview: Another incident will teach Xander (Enrique Gil) a lesson. How can Manong Banky (Nonong Bangkay) explain to him the real fellowship and cooperation?

videos.title: Episode 010
videos.overview: There is a new hope awaiting the La Strawberry. Can Agnes (Liza Soberano) and Xander (Enrique Gil) set aside their differences to win the competition?

videos.title: Episode 011
videos.overview: It seems like Xander (Enrique Gil) is slowly falling for Agnes (Liza Soberano), but will their families situation allow a sweet relationship to bloom between the two?

videos.title: Episode 012
videos.overview: Because of the accident, Xander (Enrique Gil) volunteers to take the place of Andrew (Yves Flores). Can Agnes (Liza Soberano) finally learn to trust him?

videos.title: Episode 013
videos.overview: Agnes (Liza Soberano) gradually sees the good in Xander (Enrique Gil) and a beautiful friendship bloom amid the sweet strawberries of La Presa.

videos.title: Episode 014
videos.overview: The Miss Strawberia contest is Xander's (Enrique Gil) chance to make it up to Agnes (Liza Soberano) and her family. Will La Presa again be reluctant to trust Xander?

videos.title: Episode 015
videos.overview: After spending all his time, would Agnes (Liza Soberano) still be able to forgive Xander (Enrique Gil)?

videos.title: Episode 016
videos.overview: Xander (Enrique Gil) finds a way to regain Agnes' (Liza Soberano) trust.

videos.title: Episode 017
videos.overview: When someone you like super is hurt, you'll definitely do everything just to win her back. The new vehicle and food failed, so Xander (Enrique Gil) searches for that one person who's very close to Agnes' (Liza Soberano) heart.

videos.title: Episode 018
videos.overview: You'll never know a person until you discover his past. You get the real Alexander Grande III (Enrique Gil).

videos.title: Episode 019
videos.overview: Xander (Enrique Gil) left La Presa and it is through his absence that Agnes (Liza Soberano) slowly realizes how important he is to her.

videos.title: Episode 020
videos.overview: Everything happens at the right place and time. Is this the right opportunity to greet Agnes (Liza Soberano) and Xander (Enrique Gil)?

videos.title: Episode 021
videos.overview: They have learned to let go to face a new beginning. The warm breeze of love beats the cold weather of La Preza as Agnes (Liza Soberano) and Xander (Enrique Gil) give each other another chance.

videos.title: Episode 022
videos.overview: Are the La Straw's superstitions supposed to be true about strawberries? Xander (Enrique Gil) and Agnes (Liza Soberano) are about to harvest the sweetest fruit of their friendship.

videos.title: Episode 023
videos.overview: Is the myth of the twin strawberries getting too real for Agnes (Liza Soberano) and Xander (Enrique Gil)?

videos.title: Episode 024
videos.overview: The Xand-Nes (Enrique Gil and Liza Soberano) relationship goes through the colorful phases of understanding, jealousy and LQ. Love to be the next stage?

videos.title: Episode 025
videos.overview: The mystery girl is back, so how does the drama "love moves in mysterious ways" was Agnes (Liza Soberano) and Xander (Enrique Gil)?

videos.title: Episode 026
videos.overview: It seems that the "Legend of the Twin Strawberries" has come true. But the return of the mystery girl may put an end to this belief.

videos.title: Episode 027
videos.overview: Will the beginning of a business merger between the Saavedras and the Grandes be the end of a blossoming love between Agnes (Liza Soberano) and Xander (Enrique Gil)? Is Xander able to forget Agnes?

videos.title: Episode 028
videos.overview: What started out as a day filled with happiness ends in tragedy. Will Xander (Enrique Gil) find Agnes (Liza Soberano) before it's too late?

videos.title: Episode 029
videos.overview: To the rescue si superman Xander. After almost losing Agnes, the XandNes "kilig" reaches intensity 10.

videos.title: Episode 030
videos.overview: Bettina (Lilet) thinks of a way to end Xander's (Enrique Gil) relationship with Agnes (Liza Soberano) and the people of La Presa.

videos.title: Episode 031
videos.overview: Super in love Superman Xander (Enrique Gil). Will he be able to handle his Supergirl Agnes (Liza Soberano)?

videos.title: Episode 032
videos.overview: Xander (Enrique Gil) invites Agnes (Liza Soberano) and the people of La Presa to the Grande's Christmas party, which is not a good idea for Bettina (Lilet).

videos.title: Episode 033
videos.overview: Xander's (Enrique Gil) rift with his mother worsens as he continues to feel like a pawn in their business with the Saavedras, while Bettina (Lilet) further despises his son's closeness with the farmers. Get ready because Bettina has a surprise that can ruin the most romantic dance of Agnes (Liza Soberano) and Xander (Enrique Gil).

videos.title: Episode 034
videos.overview: Today marks the battle between the FJ- Fomer "Jowa" and the PJ- Present "Jowa." Will the return of Xander's (Enrique Gil) ex-girlfriend ruin the magic between him and his superwoman Agnes (Liza Soberano)?

videos.title: Episode 035
videos.overview: The FJ (Former "Jowa") vs. PJ (Present "Jowa) battle heats up as Bettina (Lilet) sets up a plan to ruin Xander's (Enrique Gil) relationship with Agnes (Liza Soberano) and the people of La Presa.

videos.title: Episode 036
videos.overview: Level up are the challenges of super couple, but at the end of the day XandNes (Enrique Gil and Liza Soberano) still have the win!

videos.title: Episode 037
videos.overview: XandNes becomes sadness as the night turns sour for Agnes (Liza Soberano) when she joins Xander (Enrique Gil) in Kate's (Sofia Andres) food-tasting event.

videos.title: Episode 038
videos.overview: Agnes (Liza Soberano) is finally saying yes to Xander (Enrique Gil) while Bettina's (Lilet) anger deepens after the Saavedras suddenly express their hesitation on their pending business partnership.

videos.title: Episode 039
videos.overview: Get ready for a super "kilig" overload because Agnes (Liza Soberano) is about to reveal her true feelings for Xander (Enrique Gil), but this can only happen if a shooting star shows up.

videos.title: Episode 040
videos.overview: Xander (Enrique Gil) and Agnes (Liza Soberano) are on Cloud 9 but Agnes panics when Xander tells her that Dona Soledad wants to meet the new girlfriend.

videos.title: Episode 041
videos.overview: Agnes (Liza Soberano) meets Xander's (Enrique Gil) family over dinner and the taste of the conversation may not be too pleasant for the new couple.

videos.title: Episode 042
videos.overview: Bettina (Lilet) helps Agnes (Liza Soberano) become one of their foundation's scholars. But her kindness has a price.

videos.title: Episode 043
videos.overview: While Agnes (Liza Soberano) is busy, Bettina (Lilet) tries to push Kate (Sofia Andres) back into Xander's (Enrique Gil) life.

videos.title: Episode 044
videos.overview: It's the season to be extra sweet and jolly because Xander (Enrique Gil) is about to surprise the people of La Presa, especially Agnes (Liza Soberano).

videos.title: Episode 045
videos.overview: Xander (Enrique Gil) travels to Cebu for two weeks with Kate (Sofia Andres) for a hotel management conference. Agnes (Liza Soberano) claims to be okay about it. But will she remain okay with it for long?

videos.title: Episode 046
videos.overview: Agnes (Liza Soberano) becomes the hotel nanny of Hotel Grande's most important guest. Level up na ang challenge at kakayanin kaya ito ni Lois Lane?

videos.title: Episode 047
videos.overview: Love is not just about the "kilig" as Agnes (Liza Soberano) and Xander's (Enrique Gil) relationship enters a shaky status.

videos.title: Episode 048
videos.overview: It seems like Superman lost his powers and forgot about Lois Lane. Kate (Sofia Andres) is that the kryptonite that will destroy Xagnes (Enrique Gil and Liza Soberano) love team?

videos.title: Episode 049
videos.overview: Agnes (Liza Soberano) is in trouble and her Superman returns to save her. How long can Agnes prove to herself in the family of Xander (Enrique Gil)?

videos.title: Episode 050
videos.overview: Bettina (Lilet) finally tells Xander (Enrique Gil) how she truly feels about her son's relationship with Agnes (Liza Soberano). Magiging "ForeverNomore" na ba ang Xagnes love story?

videos.title: Episode 051
videos.overview: Xander (Enrique Gil) chooses to be with Agnes (Liza Soberano) and her family in La Presa, which prompts Doña Soledad (Marissa Delgado) to introduce the new face of Grande.

videos.title: Episode 052
videos.overview: Doña Soledad (Marissa Delgado) has chosen Julius San Juan (Kit Thompson) to replace Xander (Enrique Gil), but Bettina (Lilet) will do everything to get her son back.

videos.title: Episode 053
videos.overview: Xander (Enrique Gil) will do anything to help Agnes (Liza Soberano) and the people of La Presa, even if it means asking a favor from his ex-girlfriend Kate (Sofia Andres).

videos.title: Episode 054
videos.overview: The past is catching up on Xander (Enrique Gil) after Kate's (Sofia Andres) admission of still being in love with him.

videos.title: Episode 055
videos.overview: Desperate to save Kate (Sofia Andres) from her depression, Mr. Saavedra (Michael Flores) heads to La Presa to ask if Xander (Enrique Gil) still has feelings for his daughter, but Xander can only give him one sure answer.

videos.title: Episode 056
videos.overview: The Saavedras blame Xander (Enrique Gil) for Kate's (Sofia Andres) misfortune and start to terrorize the people of La Presa as their form of revenge.

videos.title: Episode 057
videos.overview: How much can Agnes (Liza Soberano) sacrifice to save Kate (Sofia Andres) from the misery that she is in?

videos.title: Episode 058
videos.overview: Agnes' (Liza Soberano) faith and trust in Xander (Enrique Gil) will be put to a test as Kate's (Sofia Andres) situation becomes worst.

videos.title: Episode 059
videos.overview: Kate (Sofia Andres) still wants Xander (Enrique Gil) to be with her and Agnes (Liza Soberano) has to give way.

videos.title: Episode 060
videos.overview: Agnes (Liza Soberano) is on a thin line between unconditional love and being blind. How long can she hold on before she falls on the wrong side?

videos.title: Episode 061
videos.overview: Will Kate (Sofia Andres) finally let go of Xander (Enrique Gil) so he can be with the woman that truly makes him happy?

videos.title: Episode 062
videos.overview: Supergirl Agnes (Liza Soberano) won't be wearing jacket in a very special day with Superman Xander (Enrique Gil). Mukhang kabado ata si Tatay Bubs (Joey Marquez).

videos.title: Episode 063
videos.overview: Xander (Enrique Gil) prepares something special to make it up to Agnes (Liza Soberano). But Kate (Sofia Andres) is planning a surprise as well.

videos.title: Episode 064
videos.overview: Kate (Sofia Andres) starts to slither her way back to Xander (Enrique Gil) and Agnes' (Liza Soberano) life.

videos.title: Episode 065
videos.overview: Can Agnes (Liza Soberano) still tolerate Kate's (Sofia Andres) presence in her Monthsary celebration with Xander (Enrique Gil) and the people of La Presa?

videos.title: Episode 066
videos.overview: Kate's (Sofia Andres) obsession with Xander (Enrique Gil) worsens to the point that she can physically hurt Agnes (Liza Soberano) and make the people of La Presa suffer.

videos.title: Episode 067
videos.overview: The Saavedras lay down an offer that can save Agnes' (Liza Soberano) family from losing La Presa and the choice has to be made by Xander (Enrique Gil).

videos.title: Episode 068
videos.overview: Some people already think that Xander (Enrique Gil) is bad luck for La Presa, but Agnes (Liza Soberano) and her family will do everything to protect the Xagnes' super relationship.

videos.title: Episode 069
videos.overview: Kate (Sofia Andres) still wants Xander (Enrique Gil) back and she will never give up, even if it means taking away everything that the Grandes have worked hard for.

videos.title: Episode 070
videos.overview: Xander (Enrique Gil), Agnes (Liza Sobeano) and the people of La Presa are willing to fight for what is right, but until when?

videos.title: Episode 071
videos.overview: More people will suffer because of Xander (Enrique Gil) and Agnes' (Liza Soberano) fight for true love. Is love enough enough to make them happy?

videos.title: Episode 072
videos.overview: Agnes (Liza Soberano) feels nothing else but hate for the Saavedras, and learning that Xander (Enrique Gil) was asking for Kate's help only worsens the situation.

videos.title: Episode 073
videos.overview: Xander (Enrique Gil) has made a decision and it's the one that can save La Presa but hurt the woman that he promised to love forever.

videos.title: Episode 074
videos.overview: Xander (Enrique Gil) decides to put an end to all the punishment that La Presa has been experiencing because of him. He finally makes his greatest sacrifice for love.

videos.title: Episode 075
videos.overview: Agnes (Liza Soberano) starts anew in Manila as she goes back to school with the twins. But then she receives news that may change her life forever.

videos.title: Episode 076
videos.overview: Agnes (Liza Soberano) decides to move on and now lives in Manila with her father, Mang Bubs (Joey Marquez). But the city may only lead Agnes to another important person from her past.

videos.title: Episode 077
videos.overview: Destiny gives Agnes (Liza Soberano) a second chance, but can she really say that she has already moved on?

videos.title: Episode 078
videos.overview: The waiting will not last forever, as Agnes and Xander's paths cross once again.

videos.title: Episode 079
videos.overview: Agnes (Liza Soberano) seems to have moved on, but will she step back when she sees Xander (Enrique Gil) again?

videos.title: Episode 080
videos.overview: Tatay Bubs (Joey Marquez) and Miss Mirasol (Irma Adlawan) are about to get married but one person from the past can change everything.
